name: houston
description: Mac menubar app — live context % per Claude session, Start-mission spawning, per-server dev-server controls, and a Settings-driven onboarding flow. Successor to the local Next.js Mission Control dashboard, now packaged for distribution.
notes: Houston's onboarding flow has been rewritten to match the linked Figma design — a clean white window with hidden title bar, an animated Welcome screen that auto-advances, and a top-bar chrome (Back / step dots / Skip) with a floating circular arrow as Continue. Background art (rocket+smoke on Welcome, astronaut bottom-right on Projects-folder + Terminal-apps) lives in a dedicated z-0 layer with SVG aspect ratios restored, multi-terminal selection + permissions step are wired in, and step content is vertically centered. Next: fully restart Electron (main-process changes don't hot-reload) and walk through the new flow end-to-end.
